title: 第7章 异父异母娶了就是第8章 五年后她成了他老婆
slug: 领证爽约我转嫁你哥哭什么
content_zh:
第7章异父异母，娶了就是电话那头被掐断。
一瞬间。
纪寒胸口燃起一丝不安，为刚才电话里的男声而心慌愤怒。
那个男人是唐凝新找的男人？
只不过很快，纪寒又溢出声不屑的冷哼。
为了惩罚他，竟然连这种手段都使得出来。
她真是一如既往的骄纵任性，又想用各种手段逼走宁宁！
……
与此同时，别墅。
“电话挂了。”纪瑾修伸手抵给唐凝手机，漆黑的眸子在她脸上探究，“会不会怪我自作主张？”
唐凝摇摇头，“不会。”
纪瑾修眼底的冷色柔下来，唇角若有似无勾起，“嗯，长大了。”
他抬手，揉揉她的脑袋。
唐凝脸微垂，缓缓抬起眼皮看他。
对上眼前一双漆黑含笑，再不似从前冷漠的眸子。
他反而更像一个大哥哥了，对她充满疼惜。
唐凝心口一顿。
他也许是为纪寒对她的伤害感到抱歉，对她怜悯，做出补偿吧。
但她始终想不明白，纪瑾修为什么要选择和她结婚，即便之前已经给出了理由。
唐凝敛收思绪，轻声：“纪大哥，有件事需要你帮忙。”

想到纪寒应该是去过她住的地方找她了，她不想再和他有任何接触。
纪瑾修眉头微不可察蹙了一下，“叫我什么？”
唐凝愣了几秒，试探性改口：“瑾修？”
她声音轻柔，眼神夹带一丝不确定的询问，看着就像一只怯生生的猫。
纪瑾修不忍心继续为难，眉头舒展，“你说，什么事？”
唐凝暗松口气，“我想卖房，你帮我处理下？”
“可以。”纪瑾修眼底闪过抹异色，“我让陈斌处理好。”
唐凝扬唇微笑：“谢谢。”
屋顶的灯光笼罩在她身上，衬得她面容柔和恬美。
白皙的肌肤在灯光下格外耀眼，笑容明媚，仅一眼，足以驱散人心头的烦闷。
纪瑾修眼神微凝。
content_en:
Chapter 7: Half-father and half-mother, if you get married, the other end of the phone will be cut off.
For a moment.
Ji Han felt a twinge of uneasiness in his chest, feeling flustered and angry at the male voice on the phone just now.
Is that man Tang Ning's new man?
But soon, Ji Han let out a disdainful snort.
In order to punish him, even this method was used.
She is as arrogant and willful as ever, and wants to use various means to force Ning Ning away!
…
Meanwhile, the villa.
"The call has been hung up." Ji Jinxiu put his hand to Tang Ning's phone, his dark eyes searching her face, "Do you blame me for making my own decision?"
Tang Ning shook her head, "No."
The cold look in Ji Jinxiu's eyes softened, and the corners of his lips seemed to curl up, "Well, I've grown up."
He raised his hand and rubbed her head.
Tang Ning's face dropped slightly, and she slowly raised her eyelids to look at him.
When he met a pair of dark smiles in front of him, his eyes were no longer as cold as before.
Instead, he became more like a big brother, full of love and affection for her.
Tang Ning was heartbroken.
Maybe he was sorry for the harm Ji Han had done to her, showed mercy to her, and made amends.
But she still couldn't figure out why Ji Jinxiu chose to marry her, even though the reasons had been given before.
Tang Ning collected her thoughts and whispered: "Brother Ji, I need your help with something."
Thinking that Ji Han had probably gone to where she lived to look for her, she didn't want to have any more contact with him.
Ji Jinxiu frowned slightly, "What did you call me?"
Tang Ning was stunned for a few seconds, then tentatively changed her words: "Jin Xiu?"
Her voice was soft, and her eyes held a hint of uncertainty, making her look like a timid cat.
Ji Jinxiu couldn't bear to continue to be embarrassed and frowned, "What do you mean?"
Tang Ning secretly breathed a sigh of relief, "I want to sell my house, can you help me handle it?"
"Okay." Ji Jinxiu's eyes flashed with a strange look, "I'll let Chen Bin handle it."
Tang Ning raised her lips and smiled: "Thank you."
The lights from the roof shrouded her body, making her face soft and peaceful.
The fair skin is particularly dazzling under the light, and the smile is bright. Just one glance is enough to dispel the worries in people's hearts.
Ji Jinxiu's eyes narrowed slightly.
